caption: The video captures a ponytailed woman in a bright, minimalist dance studio with white walls, a light wood floor, ceiling track lights, and a wall-mounted air conditioner. She wears a black sleeveless top, sheer asymmetrical skirt, black leg warmers, and heeled shoes, holding a left-facing profile with arms crossed over her chest. A floor-to-ceiling mirror on the right reflects her back beside a white curtain and a white triangular frame, while the camera and background stay fixed. Her upper hand drifts between neck and chest, and a pendant becomes visible against her torso. The front leg on the left straightens from an angled, heel-lifted pose toward a more grounded stance, a slow weight shift rather than a step. Her shoulders and torso open slightly toward the camera while her head keeps facing left. The sheer skirt flap sways and repositions with this subtle movement. The mirror reflection tracks the same figure, mirroring the leg and skirt changes in sync.
